doc: Short-term memory of turns in Postgres: what the bot heard and said, added after 0002 so every existing database upgrades in place (decision D165). One row per message a Conversation committed, in words, beside the short-term register of admitted stimuli. No data moves.

upgrade.sql: CREATE TABLE bot_stm_turn (seq SERIAL NOT NULL, turn_id TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL, direction TEXT NOT NULL, speakers_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, cut INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, conversation TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (seq))
